content: Why Bayesian Optimization Can Fall Short for Materials Innovation In the rapidly evolving world of AI within materials and chemicals industries, Bayesian optimization (BO) has re-emerged as a powerful tool. In this blog post, we will explore why BO may not be suitable for all AI purposes in this domain.
